Marketing- Development and implementation of marketing and communications activities in line with the overall business strategy- Strengthening and further development of the AutoGyro brand and its positioning in relevant markets- Development and implementation of PR, media relations and brand storytelling activities- Planning and execution of promotional campaigns and initiatives to increase brand awareness and market presence- Conceptualization and execution of premium events, trade shows, customer experiences and other promotional activities- Development of compelling brand experiences and experiential marketing concepts such as “The Art of Flying”- Identification and development of relevant partnerships, cooperation opportunities and business development initiatives- Management of awards submissions and other opportunities to increase brand visibility- Development of merchandising concepts and a consistent, premium-oriented brand environment- Acting as a brand ambassador and spokesperson in selected channels and at relevant events- Supporting the Head of Sales at official events, customer meetings, international appointments and other external activities- Close collaboration with Sales and other internal stakeholders on brand, communication and business development topics- Monitoring relevant market, luxury, lifestyle and aviation trends and translating insights into marketing and business opportunities- Supporting the development of communication materials, campaigns and content across relevant channelsRequirements- Degree in Marketing, Communications, PR, Media, Business or a comparable qualification- Professional experience in marketing, communications, PR, events or a comparable field- Strong expertise in Brand Communication, PR, Storytelling and promotional activities- Experience in event management and the creation of engaging customer experiences- Strong understanding of brand development and commercial positioning- Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English- Confident and professional appearance when representing the company externally- Creative mindset combined with strong organizational and project management skills- Structured, independent and hands-on working style with a high sense of quality- Willingness to travel for customer events, trade shows and official appointments- Experience in luxury, premium brands, aviation, lifestyle or high-end technical products is a strong plus- Experience in business development, strategic partnerships or merchandising is a plus- Passion for aviation!Application TaskTo ensure a fair and comparable assessment of all applicants, the following task is part of the application process:- Social Media Post: Create a fictional social media post for a platform of your choice promoting AutoGyro’s participation as an exhibitor at a major international trade fair. The objective is to attract attention, generate interest and encourage visitors to visit the AutoGyro booth.- Video Reel: Create a short video reel, e.g. for Instagram, that conveys the beauty and fascination of flying in an emotional way and presents the AutoGyro brand in a visually appealing manner.Please note: Applications submitted without completing the required task cannot be considered, as the task is an integral part of the selection process and allows us to assess all applicants on a comparable basis.Benefits- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.- Supportive and international team culture.- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then join AutoGyro GmbH.We are the world market leader in the development, production and sale of gyrocopters and work with partners in more than 40 countries. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high degree of vertical integration and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we are actively shaping the future.Since our foundation in 1999, we have grown steadily and now employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. Through our global sales network, we are consistently pursuing our goal: to bring the thrill of flying, maximum safety and the versatile applications of the Gyro to people all over the world.
